from pathlib import Path
import csv, hashlib, json, subprocess
root=Path.cwd(); p=root/'udt_finite_clock_metric_variation_2026-09-28'
launch=json.loads((p/'LAUNCH.json').read_text())
maintained={'LIVE.md','HANDOFF.md','CURRENT_RESEARCH_PROGRAM.md','MEMORY.md','INDEX.md','UDT_RESEARCH_ROADMAP.md'}
def check(base, mapping):
    for name,h in mapping.items():
        assert hashlib.sha256((base/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h,name
check(root,{f:h for f,h in launch['source_pins'].items() if f not in maintained})
freeze=json.loads((p/'CANDIDATE_FREEZE.json').read_text())
check(p,freeze['candidate_and_checks'])
for name in ['SOURCE_FIRST_SEAL','DIRECT_INDEPENDENT_SEAL','DIRECT_REVIEW_SEAL']:
    check(root,json.loads((p/'review'/f'{name}.json').read_text())['files'])
rows={r['premise_id']:r for r in csv.DictReader((root/'CURRENT_SCIENTIFIC_PREMISES.tsv').open(),delimiter='\t')}
assert len(rows)==406
selected=json.loads((p/'SCOPED_REGISTRY.json').read_text())
assert all(rows[r['premise_id']]==r for r in selected)
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git','-c','core.preloadIndex=false','-c','index.threads=1',*args],text=True)
assert git('branch','--show-current').strip()=='grok'
assert git('rev-parse','HEAD').strip()==launch['head']
assert git('rev-parse','origin/grok').strip()==launch['origin_grok']
untracked=set(git('ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard').splitlines())
assert {f for f in untracked if not f.startswith(p.name+'/')}==set(launch['prior_untracked_paths'])
assert set(git('diff','--name-only').splitlines())==maintained
assert not git('diff','--cached','--name-only').strip()
before=git('show',launch['head']+':CURRENT_RESEARCH_PROGRAM.md')
assert before.split('## Current next gate')[0]==(root/'CURRENT_RESEARCH_PROGRAM.md').read_text().split('## Current next gate')[0]
assert not git('diff','--check')
size=sum(f.stat().st_size for f in p.rglob('*') if f.is_file())
assert size<2*1024**2,size
print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','evidence':'correspondence/preservation only','prior_untracked_paths_preserved':len(launch['prior_untracked_paths']),'registry_rows_unchanged':len(rows),'selected_rows_verified':len(selected),'candidate_pins':len(freeze['candidate_and_checks']),'review_seals_verified':3,'maintained':sorted(maintained),'founding_opening_unchanged':True,'package_bytes':size},indent=2))
